manifest.title: Hamburgers (371C)
manifest.statement: Recipe over B/S/C of length 1–100. Initial stocks and unit prices 1–100, budget 1–10^12. Maximize number of complete hamburgers. Source: https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/371/C

package.reference:
recipe=input()
stock=list(map(int,input().split()))
price=list(map(int,input().split()))
money=int(input())
need=[recipe.count(c) for c in "BSC"]
made=0
# Spend on at most 100 individual burgers until required stocks run out.
while any(n and a for n,a in zip(need,stock)):
    cost=sum(max(0,n-a)*p for n,a,p in zip(need,stock,price))
    if cost>money:
        break
    money-=cost
    stock=[max(0,a-n) for a,n in zip(stock,need)]
    made+=1
if not any(n and a for n,a in zip(need,stock)):
    made+=money//sum(n*p for n,p in zip(need,price))
print(made)

hamburgers.correct:
s=input()
nb,ns,nc=map(int,input().split())
pb,ps,pc=map(int,input().split())
n=int(input())
cb,cs,cc=s.count('B'),s.count('S'),s.count('C')
def good(mid):
    b=max(cb*mid-nb,0)
    s=max(cs*mid-ns,0)
    c=max(cc*mid-nc,0)
    return b*pb+s*ps+c*pc<=n
l,r,ans=0,10**13,0
while l<=r:
    mid=(l+r)//2
    if good(mid):
        ans=mid
        l=mid+1
    else:
        r=mid-1
print(ans)

manifest.title: Two sum — any valid pair
manifest.statement: Read n (2..6), target k (0..20), and n integers (0..9). Print any two distinct 1-based indices whose values sum to k, or NONE if no pair exists.

package.reference:
n,k=map(int,input().split())
a=list(map(int,input().split()))
ans='NONE'
for i in range(n):
 for j in range(i+1,n):
  if a[i]+a[j]==k: ans=f'{i+1} {j+1}'
print(ans)
